comments.story: Arctic Is Warming At 'Astonishing' Rates, Researchers Say
comments.why: Debunks a dozen climate myths in under seven minutes
comments.text: Veritassium debunks this claim on climate change, along with a dozen others, in less than 7 minutes in an informative and entertaining way. It's a great video, you should at least watch it. [VIDEO] In short, during the 70s, there were some papers on global cooling. But even then, there was still 6 times more papers on global warming. Science overall has been looking in the correct direction for a long time now. The narrative isn't changing.

comments.author: sinxoveretothex
comments.story: CO2 levels mark 'new era' in the world's changing climate
comments.why: Supporting source on human net CO2 emissions
comments.text: Humans are not the primary source in the tricky sense that someone looking to deny the evidence couldn't deny. But they are the primary source of the net emissions or, in other words, the increase of CO2 levels. It's a bit like if your neighbor produces just enough grain for a year's worth of food for his family of 10 and you steal just enough for yourself. Technically, you aren't the primary source of the decrease in food, but you are the primary (and only) source of the fact that your neighbor's food supply are lower than needed.
